existing_systems: The canonical development branch already has design, wonder and spine verification commands.
root_problem: An evergreen example-only preflight allows new architecture changes to pass without their own review.
reuse_decision: Extend the existing design and CI workflow rather than introducing another architecture authority.
integration_impact: The preflight applies across kernel, native Wyrdrune, sensory UI, Observer, Return and cloud host changes.
complete_operation: Require a branch-specific changed preflight file covering all changed system paths on each Wayglass pull request.
verification_plan: Run Node unit tests and GitHub Actions PR-scoped checks with both positive and missing-manifest negative cases.
return_continuity: Preserve the reviewed head ref and exact changed file scope in versioned repository evidence.
remaining_boundaries: The workflow is not a model worker and does not establish live browser, provider, deployment or runtime verification.
withness_wholeness: One shared review contract catches duplicated architecture across the full ship without replacing existing engines.
